content: .NET 8+ container images changed the default ASP.NET Core port from 80 to 8080 specifically so non-root container users can bind it (ports <1024 need root). ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS is a simpler alternative to ASPNETCORE_URLS accepting a semicolon-delimited port list; ASPNETCORE_URLS remains supported and takes full scheme://host:port syntax.
